newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki down as bears pace quiet, nervous bourse.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki down as bears pace quiet, nervous bourse.

text.p: Shares fell on Monday as broad bearish sentiment dominated in quiet, edgy trade, and brokers said weakness would continue unless Wall Street recovers.
The HEX index fell 1.64 percent to close at 2,846.11 points and the options exchange's FOX portfolio benchmark index fell 1.74 percent to close below 1,000-point support at 998.85.
"I think we are in for a correction, this market could easily fall five percent ... the sooner the better," one broker said. "The early-year buying seems to have come to an end."
Telecoms major Nokia fell 6.50 to 297.00 markka, accounting for just over a quarter of total volume.

UPM-Kymmene fell 1.20 markka to 104.80 ahead of its results due at 0900/0700 GMT on Tuesday in relatively lively trade -- brokers said it was unlikely the report could change overall glum sentiment even if it contained a positive surprise.
Oil and chemicals group Neste fell 6.4 percent or 9.00 markka to 131.00, extending losses after reporting a disappointing profit and dividend last week.
Finnlines was off 7.00 markka or over five percent at 130.00 in active dealings, as it went ex a four markka dividend.
